record.title: Restore setup code mappings before the unchanged external reader
record.intent: Test whether explicit removal of setup instrumentation restores stock code bytes and permissions for a strict detached cached-data read.
requirements: Commit and push admitted tasking before implementation. Preserve cached-identity-reader-01 as a failed control; retain unchanged pinned reader build06, stock APK/library and strict ELF/maps gates.

Capture actual loaded stock code bytes and exact library mappings at experiment entry before any Auklet hook. Require expected RX and RELRO/data geometry. Preserve the setup baseline separately from reader observation.

After the final stock identity call, detach owned observers, revert the synthetic DNA replacement and flush. Verify full original executable bytes are restored before restoring only changed originally RX page permissions to their captured r-x values. Fail on unexpected bytes, mappings or permissions; do not relax the reader or change policy.

Prove byte equality and complete library mapping equality with the initial setup baseline before ready acknowledgement, unload and detach. Any setup protection operation must precede external reading and be explicitly logged.

Run one fresh disposable guest control with the same three negative cases followed by the positive two-sample 48-byte maximum read. Retain process identity, exact read counts, independent address/byte comparison, raw policy snapshots, health, durable journals and hashes.

No physical contact, acquired key use, License initialization, installation, ADC/AFE run, automatic fallback or policy/credential change. Preserve the first unexpected failure and do not adjust a running experiment.
acceptance: A strict reader pass or exact remaining setup/read dependency is preserved and independently evaluated.
